global.title: What will it take to build a moon base?
global.summary: In this episode, a panel of industry experts discuss what’s needed to build a moon base. During a live event at the Johns Hopkins University Bloomberg Center, leaders Astrolab, Firefly Space and APL share what a lunar future could look like and what has to happen in the next couple of years to make it a reality. global.title: Astrolight delivers first space-to-ground laser communication link to client
global.summary: WARSAW, Poland — The Lithuanian space startup Astrolight has announced the successful commissioning of a space-to-ground laser communication link. The link company’s ATLAS-1 laser communication terminal aboard ERMIS-3, an 8U cubesat led by the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens as part of the ERMIS mission, connected with HolOGS-1, the optical ground station of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki in Greece.
